title: Examining the effect of adding negative values to missing
author: Moseley Bioinformatics Lab
date: last-modified
format:

    embed-resources: true
---

## Purpose

We want to know if we can just add negatives to the missing, and keep going.

So what I did, is I only considered the datasets that have at least two negative values in them.
I took the actual missing values (end up as `NA` in the raw data), did the test for left-censorship, and then made anything $\le 0$ as missing, and did the test again.

**If there were no missing values initially, I recorded the p-value as 1, and the estimate as 0.**

To put a p-value on this, I also did a binomial test of the differences in log-p-value and ratio of effect sizes, both where I just removed no-change and where we consider no-change as being equal to positive change (i.e. more extreme p-value or larger effect size).


```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| echo: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 8,
  dev = c("ragg_png", "svg"),
  dpi = 600
)
```

```{r}
#| label: targets
targets::tar_source(c("./packages.R", "R"))
tar_load(sets_neg_test_result)
```

```{r}
#| label: function-modify
put_tables_together = function(in_tbl, tbl_names = c("all", "ssf")) {
  # in_tbl = sets_neg_test_result$p_tests$remove_zero$binom_test
  in_tbl = in_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(subset = tbl_names)
  in_tbl |>
    dplyr::select(subset, p.value, statistic, estimate) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::fmt_scientific(columns = c(p.value), decimals = 2) |>
    gt::fmt_number(columns = c(estimate), decimals = 3)
}
```

## Results

### Change In P-Values

```{r}
#| label: fig-p-values
#| fig-cap: Histogram of the differences in p-values using just missing, or also considering negative values as missing.
sets_neg_test_result$p_histogram
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-p-values-nozero
#| tbl-cap: Binomial test of changing p-values when adding negatives to missing, but removing zero change.
sets_neg_test_result$p_tests$remove_zero$binom_test |>
  put_tables_together()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-p-values-addzero
#| tbl-cap: Binomial test of changing p-value when adding negatives to missing, but including zero change as a positive.
sets_neg_test_result$p_tests$zero_to_positive$binom_test |>
  put_tables_together()
```

### Change in Estimate

```{r}
#| label: fig-estimate
#| fig-cap: Histogram of the differences in estimate using just missing, or also considering negative values as missing.
sets_neg_test_result$estimate_histogram
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-estimate-nozero
#| tbl-cap: Binomial test of changing estimate when adding negatives to missing, but removing zero change.
sets_neg_test_result$estimate_tests$remove_zero$binom_test |>
  put_tables_together()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-estimate-addzero
#| tbl-cap: Binomial test of changing estimate when adding negatives to missing, but including zero change as a positive.
sets_neg_test_result$estimate_tests$zero_to_positive$binom_test |>
  put_tables_together()
```
